subject: 五髻文殊菩萨
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE portrait 1024x1536 photorealistic museum reference visualization of the specific Yingxian Wooden Pagoda fifth-floor painted clay statue in reference image 1. Reference image 2 is STYLE ONLY, never copy its Buddha identity or mudra. Exactly centered straight frontal elevation, camera at mid-height, no low angle, full seated body including crown/hair, both hands and crossed knees, closely attached lotus seat and simple immediate seat board visible with margins; omit tall lower pedestal. Neutral seamless light gray background, soft balanced diffuse lighting, subtle contact shadow, sharp tactile clay and mineral pigments, no flesh or plastic CGI. Preserve individual face proportions, sculpted garment, ornaments and photographed hand gestures rather than generic iconography. Remove temple and all other figures. No text, watermark, halo, collage or diptych. AI visualization not documentary evidence. Unseen details inferred conservatively. Subject label (provisional where noted): 五髻文殊菩萨. Foreground figure only, distinctive five hair knots rather than leaf crown, cloud shoulder cape and chest panel; left hand chest high curled fingers, right forearm extended palm up. No sword or lion. PRESENT CONDITION: preserve photographed worn brown gray-beige clay, patchy pale ground, faded pigment remnants, chips and irregular abrasion. Do not restore or add vivid color.
